item.title: Media Matters weekly newsletter, February 20
item.description: Welcome back to Media Matters’ weekly newsletter. This week: Fox News has largely ignored the Epstein story. Sean Hannity is demanding military action against Iran to obliterate the nation’s nuclear program, which he had previously declared dead. Paramount is mangling CBS — and CNN may be next. This morning, the Supreme Court struck down many of President Donald Trump's sweeping tariffs. Dozens of Fox figures had cheered for the tariffs when Trump announced them.
